tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /thub pa'i rgyal tshab dpal ldan sa skya zhes yod pa'i phrin bcol// swasti/ thub pa'i rgyal tshab dpal ldan sa skya zhes/ /rgyal dang bstan 'dzin yongs kyi cher bsngags pa'i/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin dgon gnas chos srung bcas/ /sngon dus gangs ri'i khrod 'dir 'gran bral yang / /deng sang bshad sgrub ming gi lhag ma tsam/ /'khon rigs bdag cag rmongs pa bong bu'i sems/ /dgon gnas 'dzin skyong byed pa'ang dka' dus 'dir/ /ye shes spyan ldan bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /mthu stobs dpung bskyed srung skyob mi mdzad na/ /sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan sngar zhal bzhes dang / /khyad par 'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims dang / /rje btsun mal lo kha'u sku mched gnyis/ /dpal chen rga lo la sogs 'khrul zad kyi/ /skyes chen du mas sa skya'i bstan srung du/ /gnyer gtad bka' bsgo mdzad de bsnyel lags sam/ /bye brag sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga/ /gdung rgyud bu slob bcas pas dus kun tu/ /bstan bsgrubs mchod gsol bgyis pa 'bras med dam/ /yang dgos sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yis/ /sku srog nyid kyang gtang la mi zhum pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs chen gyis/ /bstan pa'i me ro gsos pa'i dge mtshan 'di/ /srid mthar mi nub rgyas phyir 'khon rgyud kun/ /srung skyobs spel ba'i byed por khyed rnams bskos/ /'khrul zad sngags 'chang bka' la'ang mi brtsi'am/ /dus phyis thams cad mkhyen pa a mes zhabs/ /dag zhing gshegs khar bstan dang bstan 'dzin bcas/ /gnyer gtad bka' bsgo mdzad phyir dam rdzas tshogs/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul stsal nas 'di skad du/ /mchod sprin 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs rnams/ /sa skya'i rje btsun yi dam lha tshogs dang / /khyad par bstan srung dam can thams cad la/ /'bul lo rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar ba sogs/ /thugs bzhed thams cad chos bzhin 'grub pa dang /

/khyad par dpal ldan sa skya'i chos dang srid/ /mi nub dbyar mtsho lta bur rgyas pa'i phyir/ /'jam dbyangs rnam sprul 'khon gdung chad med du/ /byon nas mdo sngags rig gnas bshad sgrub kun/ /phyogs dus gnas skabs rgyun du rgyas pa dang / /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bsam don kun 'grub bstan pa cher rgyas nas/ /phyi ma bde ba can bgrod sa lam kun/ /mthar phyin gang 'dul sprul pas srid mtha'i bar/ /sa skya'i chos srid spel ba'i mthu ldan mdzod/ /zhes sogs rnam dkar thugs bskyed smon lam dang / /gnyer gtad bka' bsgo mdzad la'ang rjes med dam/ /'bras bu rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /puṇ+ya rat+na thar rtse grub pa'i dbang / /'jam mgon gnas gsar 'dren mchog brag rtsa ba/ /'khrul zad kun gyi bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'di nas bzung byang chen ma thob bar/ /dam can rgya mtsho khyod la gnyer gtad nas/ /gnas skabs 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /mthar thug mchog gi dngos grub stsol zhig ces/ /lan cig min par yang yang bka' stsal te/ /mthar thug lta zhog lo shas mi rtag par/ /stong grogs med pa'i snang tshul 'di ltar na/ /nyams chung bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas rnams/ /'phral yun blo gtad 'chol ba'i yul de su/ /'on te gdul bya'i zhing du ma gyur na/ /bsod dman spun kyang snyigs dus bstan mjug 'dir/ /sa skya'i rigs su skyes ba'i bar srid de/ /thog ma nyid nas rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' ru/ /mi bskrod rgyu mtshan 'di ko ci zhig yin/ /sngags dang ting 'dzin rjes kun ma tshang yang / /lhag bsam dag pas gsol 'debs 'bad lags na/ /chos skyong mi zad gzan skyong mdzad dam ci/ /de bas mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpung yod na/ /deng sang sa skya'i rje btsun bstan pa 'di/ /srung skyob spel ba'i dus su babs lags pas/ /'khon rigs bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la/

/sngon las 'phral rkyen nad gdon 'byung po'i tshogs/ /mi 'dod nyer 'tshe phyi nang gsang gsum kun/ /'phral du zhi zhing bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /mthun rkyen chos srid dpal 'byor dbyar mtsho ltar/ /'phel zhing rgyas nas 'jig rten khams 'di ru/ /bde skyid ma lus 'byung ba'i mthu ldan mdzod/ /lhag par 'jam mgon dpal ldan chos skyong gi /lha rdzas 'dis mtshon mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /rgyun mi chad par khyod kyi spyan sngar bstar/ /bka' bsgo 'phrin bcol gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin stsal/ /rigs kyi bu la brgyud kyi lha 'go ltar/ /'khon rigs bdag la'ang 'phrin gsol zhus shig ces/ /lan gcig min pa yang yang bka' stsal pa/ /sa bstan spyi dang bye brag dpal ldan ngor/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / /'jam mgon mchog gi sku tshe mdzad phrin rgyas/ /sa skyong sde dge'i chab srid dbu rmog btsan/ /gnas skabs mthar thug bzhed don ma lus kun/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i dge legs stsol/ /bdag cag snyigs dus mi dge 'tshe ba'i dus/ /skyabs bral mgon med smre sngags shor lags na/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i brtse chen dpung bskyed la/ /nyams thag sdug bsngal 'di las dbugs dbyung mdzod/ /skyabs chen dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / /dpal mgo+on chos skyong srung ma'i mthu stobs dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthus/ /'dod pa'i don kun 'bad med lhun grub mdzod// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ thub pa'i rgyal tshab dpal ldan sa skya zhes yod pa'i 'phrin bcol/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
